The '''Circling of the First of the Red''' was a [[Quesoth]] subcaste of the [[Circling of the Red]] caste based in<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]] that advised the [[City/Legends|city's]] ruler, the [[Queen of the Red]]. The Quesoth [[Borosiv]] was a member of the Circling of the First and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the reigning [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red's]] ally, the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]],<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Circling of the First of the Red appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
